system.description: For a brief moment, your god stands in your place. Sustained. When the spell ends, you have glimpsed what stands behind the sky.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you need not test when the spell ends.
outcomes.success: While you sustain the spell, you are immune to all damage and conditions, but you cannot move or attack; you can only pray. When it ends, test Sanity DR16 or be Stupefied for d4 rounds.
outcomes.failure: The protection lasts only until the start of your next turn, and you need not test.
outcomes.ruin: What stands behind the sky glimpses you: you are Stupefied for d4 rounds. Roll on the Shadowblight table.

outcomeEffects.note: you are immune to all damage and conditions while you sustain it (until the start of your next turn on a Failure), but you cannot move or attack; when it ends, test Sanity DR16 or be Stupefied for d4 rounds (no test on a Triumph or Failure)
